newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Poly Glass issues suspended.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Poly Glass issues suspended.

text.p: Trading in Poly Glass Fibre (M) Bhd's rights shares and warrants will be suspended indefinitely from Monday on the company's request, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said on Saturday.
The shares and warrants were to have been released soon.
It said in a statement that the company had requested the suspension because of a delay in the dispatch of provisional letters of allotment and offer for the two issues.
Poly Glass has announced a rights issue of 31.6 million shares and sale of 21.07 million warrants to its shareholders.
The company said in a statement to the stock exchange that trading could resume after letters are sent to shareholders.
However, it did not say when the letters would be sent.
